newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Esprit Asia in HK$1.8 bln European deal.
newsitem.headline: Esprit Asia in HK$1.8 bln European deal.

text.p: Esprit Asia Holdings Ltd said late on Wednesday it proposed to pay HK$1.83 billion for its chairman's interest in most of the Esprit Worldwide Companies.

It said in a statement it planned to buy 100 percent of Esprit Far East Ltd, 100 percent of Esprit de Corp Gmbh, five percent of Esprit Holdings Inc, 63 percent of Esprit International and 10 percent of Esprit Japan Ltd.
The companies together conduct or control most global distribution of Esprit products.
Esprit Asia would pay HK$1.53 billion in cash and the remaining HK$307.8 million would be paid in new shares, it said.
The HK$1.53 cash would be funded by a bank loan of HK$1.31 billion and Esprit Asia's internal resources, it said.
The proposed acquisition was primarily from a company controlled by Michael Ying Lee Yuen, chairman and majority shareholder of Esprit Asia, it said.
Shareholders of Esprit Asia, other than Ying, are required to approve the acquisition at a special general meeting expected to be held on January 7, it said.
Esprit Far East holds about 70 percent of Esprit Asia.
The operations Esprit Asia planned to buy were forecast to have a consolidated net profit of HK$187.1 million for the year to next June.
